title: Wermuth-Cox sequential treatment
content: Figure 7.6 models two treatment periods. X is randomized, W responds to X, Z is assigned in response to W, and hidden health status U confounds W and Y. The target jointly intervenes on X and Z.

variables.name: U
variables.content: The unobserved health status that causes W and Y.

variables.name: W
variables.content: The intermediate outcome observed after X.

variables.name: Z
variables.content: The second treatment assigned in response to W.

arrows.because: Figure 7.6 makes the intermediate outcome depend on Treatment 1.
Figure 7.6 gives Treatment 1 a direct arrow into the outcome.
Figure 7.6 assigns Treatment 2 in response to the intermediate outcome.
Figure 7.6 gives Treatment 2 an arrow into the outcome.
Figure 7.6 makes hidden health status a cause of the intermediate outcome.
Figure 7.6 makes hidden health status a cause of the final outcome.
